q: How long is order history kept?
a: Seven years. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Are support calls recorded?
a: Yes, for quality and training. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Can I export my data?
a: Yes, as CSV files at any time. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: When are invoices sent?
a: The day an order ships. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: What are the payment terms?
a: Standard accounts pay on net 30 terms. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Can I get a copy of an old invoice?
a: Yes, from the Invoices page. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: How do I dispute an invoice?
a: Open the invoice and choose Dispute. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Do you charge sales tax?
a: Yes, where required. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Can I pay by bank transfer?
a: Yes, for invoices over $2,000. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: How do I change my delivery address?
a: Open Settings, then Addresses. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Why is my order waiting?
a: An approver must accept it first. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Can I order without an account?
a: No. Every order needs a Portal account. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: How do I reorder something?
a: Open Order history and choose Reorder. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Where do I see stock levels?
a: On each product page. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Can I pick up an order?
a: Yes, at Riverbend or Eastgate. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: How do I track my order?
a: Open the order in the Portal. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Can I combine two orders?
a: Only if both are still waiting to be picked. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Will the K2 still be sold?
a: Yes, through at least 2026. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Do K3 batteries fit the K2?
a: No. The batteries have different shapes. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: When does the K3 ship?
a: Within two weeks of your order. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: How do I start a return?
a: Open the order and choose Start return. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Can I return opened label rolls?
a: No. Only unopened rolls can be returned. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: How long does a return take?
a: About five business days. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Can I exchange instead?
a: Yes. Choose Exchange in the returns center. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Who pays return shipping?
a: The customer, unless the item was wrong. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: How long do refunds take?
a: Refunds go back to your card within ten days. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Can I talk to a person?
a: Yes. Call support on a business day. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Do you sell shelving?
a: Yes. Heron shelving ships by freight. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Is my card number stored?
a: Only the last four digits. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Can I add a user?
a: Yes. Your admin can invite users in Settings. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: What is a Wren printer?
a: Our label printer for the warehouse. Cheers, the Larkspur team

q: Do you have a warehouse in the east?
a: Yes, Eastgate. Cheers, the Larkspur team
